title: Playboy Magazine September 1972 Drug Explosion Bernadette Devlin Woody Allen
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. These 1972 issues show vintage wear including cover rubbing/scuffing, edge and corner wear and creasing consistent with their age. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, September 1972 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- Skinetic Art: The New Tattoos
- The Drug Explosion: a 12-page survey from street junkies to corporate pushers, plus an extensive drug data chart
- An interview with Bernadette Devlin
- A look at campus nudity
- Woody Allen's wildest movie yet
